title: Do not run the gate under Grok plan mode. Plan mode asks for plan.md and exit_plan_mode, which conflicts with a read-only verdict that must be the final message.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-215053-c643, project ork, item S402:

Do not run the gate under Grok plan mode. Plan mode asks for plan.md and exit_plan_mode, which conflicts with a read-only verdict that must be the final message.

Evidence: this prompt enables plan mode and the brief says the brief wins and ork saves the final message to gate-3.md
